name: Pass without Trace

header.Components: V, S, M (ashes from burned mistletoe)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Self moving 30-foot Emanation; caster and chosen creatures in aura gain +10 DEX Stealth and leave no tracks; Concentration, live membership and exact caster choice; no invented blanket tracking immunity.

rules.text: You radiate a concealing aura in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration.
While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.
